  id = {EDN-95},
  title = {CI fails on fixable image vulnerabilities, and the containers run locked down},
  date = {2026-10-22},
  milestone = {M5: Model Packaging},
  topic = {CI/CD, Security, Containerization},
  participants = {@lukas2510 wrote issues \#199 and \#200 and merged their pull requests; the AI chose the scanner and the limits within them},
  decision = {trivy scans the API and nginx images in every integration run and in CD before the push.
It fails on HIGH or CRITICAL findings that have a fix and counts the others; \texttt{.\allowbreak{}trivyignore} takes a finding only with a reason and an expiry, which the scan tool enforces.
A canary scan of a 2023 image must fail.
Dependabot moves the digest-pinned images.
Both containers run read-only, without capabilities, with \texttt{no-\allowbreak{}new-\allowbreak{}privileges} and limits on memory and processes.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item \texttt{aquasecurity/\allowbreak{}trivy-\allowbreak{}action}: its tags were moved to a credential stealer in March 2026 (\href{https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/security/advisories/GHSA-69fq-xp46-6x23}{GHSA-69fq-xp46-6x23}), so trivy is the release binary, pinned by SHA-256.
\item Caching the vulnerability database: rebuilt every few hours, so a cache is stale.
\item Our own nginx image with \texttt{apk upgrade}: a second image to maintain; two vulnerabilities upstream has not fixed sit in \texttt{.\allowbreak{}trivyignore} until 2026-11-13.
\item Waiting for the VM load test (\#143) for the API limit: laptop measurements now, re-checked there.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} Counting unfixed findings keeps a CVE Debian has not patched from blocking every pull request (NFR-09).
The canary fails the October 2023 Python image with 93 fixable findings, so a clean result means something; the API image has none.
The API peaked at 606 to 634 MiB under 20 requests/s; 768 MiB is 1.2 to 1.3 times that, below NFR-04's 1 GB, and p95 stayed 140 to 170 ms before and 150 to 160 ms after.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI workers built the scan, the Dependabot file and the hardening, and measured the limits.
An independent review agent raised five should-fix points, all fixed; no human code review is recorded.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-10-22 that ran the AI workers on \#199 and \#200, opening prompt ``use the orchestrate skill and solve M4. don't do the report yet, I want to do it at the end. also solve bugs that exist right now or come up meanwhile and are urgent'' (translated from German).},
